title: Autoware Index distribution file
description: Schema for distributions/<distro>.yaml. Version 3 adds registered package dependencies to the repository-keyed version 2 format. Cross-entry target and cycle checks live in scripts/check_refs.py.

ros_distro.description: ROS 2 distribution name. MUST equal the filename stem (e.g. 'jazzy' for distributions/jazzy.yaml).

repositories.description: Registered repositories keyed by repository name (the registry-wide identity used in sweep artifacts, history records, and CLI .repos entries).

url.description: Git remote URL of the repository. One entry per repository; spelling variants of the same repo (.git suffix, ssh form, trailing slash) are rejected by check_refs.py. (format is annotation-only in most validators, hence the explicit minLength: an empty url would otherwise pass CI and be silently skipped by every sweep.)

reference_design.description: Optional, reviewer-granted: the named AWF reference designs whose published documentation cites this repository ('pov' = the privately-owned-vehicles design). The grant test is that citation, so any reviewer can confirm or refuse a value from public documents. The enum grows one value per design whose owners confirm its spelling; it is display and filter metadata, never a ref selector, and stays outside the sweep diff tuple.

maintainers.description: Repository-level default maintainers; a package entry may override with its own list.

packages.description: Registered ROS packages this repository hosts, keyed by ROS package name (always explicit: the key must equal the package.xml <name>). Unlisted sibling packages in the same repository are not registered: the index makes no claims about them.

tags.description: One or more tags from the closed vocabulary in schema/tags.yaml. This schema checks shape only (the item grammar mirrors registry_load.py's TAG_ID_PATTERN and length cap); membership and deprecation are enforced by scripts/check_tags.py.

description.description: Optional registry-side override for the card description. When set it wins over the package.xml <description> cached by the sweep; omit it to render the upstream description.

index_dependencies.description: Version 3 only: registered ROS package names in this same distribution required by this package. Consumers resolve the transitive closure and clone each owning repository once. Targets, self-dependencies, and cycles are checked by check_refs.py.

maintainers.description: Optional override of the repository-level maintainers for this package.

ref.description: What this repository is registered as for this distro. Single ref per (repository, distro): every registered package of the repository is validated at this one ref.

kind.description: tag/sha = pinned (immutable cells in history). branch = rolling (re-resolved by nightly sweeps).
